// dir: y
// want: analyzer "text-markers" declares "k", nothing reads it
// want: y: params are used outside a reader call: ctx.Params("typo")
// declared: text-markers=k
// with: pass
package y

import "github.com/0b1-PulsarTech/pulsarules_codex/internal/analyzer/pass"

type box[T any] struct{}

func (box[T]) take(value T) any { return value }

func run(ctx pass.Context) {
	var holder box[pass.ParamSet]
	_ = holder.take(ctx.Params("typo"))
}
